title: yencoding: YencError missing Clone derive
description:
Why this exists: yencoding/src/error.rs defines YencError with #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] but not Clone.

What goes wrong: YencError cannot be cloned. This means Result<T, YencError> cannot be cloned either, which prevents storing decode results in collections that require Clone. The uuencoding crate's UuError does derive Clone (confirmed from reading). Omitting Clone from an error type is a common oversight that makes the type harder to use in situations where results need to be propagated or stored.

Fix: add Clone to the derive list on YencError.
